title: FinQA: A Dataset of Numerical Reasoning over Financial Data
language_domain_task: English financial report table/text QA and reasoning programs
design_implication: Evidence retrieval and calculation programs are separate; execution/program accuracy have distinct limits.
transfer_limitations: Simplifies complex tables; dataset/source report redistribution rights unverified; no event extraction benchmark
reading_limitations: No dataset downloaded; no model adopted

title: SKOS Simple Knowledge Organization System Reference
design_implication: Labels, hierarchy and cross-scheme mapping have different semantics.
transfer_limitations: RDF not required; company alias/metric mappings not yet validated

title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
design_implication: Track source, extraction activity, authorship and revisions separately.
transfer_limitations: No OWL reasoning or graph implementation; attribution not correctness proof

title: The Financial Industry Business Ontology
design_rule: Candidate term source only; no term adopted
transfer_limitations: Specific ontology release/term definitions and reuse rights not checked

title: Integration of Financial Statement Analysis Techniques
read_sections_pages: Introduction; Exhibit 1 phases 1–6; public learning outcomes
design_implication: Analysis starts with purpose/questions and tracks follow-up.
transfer_limitations: Full paid reading not read; no person's analysis proficiency certified

title: Evaluating Quality of Financial Reports
language_domain_task: Financial reporting quality vs results quality
design_rule: Separate interpretation from raw facts and uncertainty
design_implication: Reporting quality and earnings/cash-flow quality are distinct analytical concepts.
transfer_limitations: No actual company quality/fraud judgement; full paid reading not read

title: Beginners' Guide to Financial Statement
read_sections_pages: Balance Sheets; Income Statements; Cash Flow; Footnotes; MD&A
design_implication: Balances are point-in-time; income and cash flows cover periods; notes/MD&A give context.
transfer_limitations: Educational brochure; not company accounting policy or authoritative GAAP measurement

title: Non-GAAP Financial Measures C&DIs
authors_or_org: US SEC Division of Corporation Finance
language_domain_task: SEC staff interpretations of non-GAAP measures
design_implication: Non-GAAP comparability requires definition; FCF lacks a uniform definition and needs clear calculation/reconciliation.
transfer_limitations: Not legal compliance assessment; company reconciliation/input completeness still unverified
